setlist.title: Beat it On Down the Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): Franklin's Tower is where the show got going and the energy picked up; Reviewer singles out Franklin's Tower as especially strong [18][20]
- **Help on the Way** (1 review): Help on the Way and Slipknot sounded somewhat bogged down at times in the opening [18]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Bobby is badly out of tune and loud, though Jerry's playing is gorgeous [22]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Deal as especially strong [20]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Cited among the spectacular performances, alongside Help>Slip>Franklin's, Brown Eyed Women, Deal and Samson>China Cat [27]

## Setlist highlights

- **Electronic Percussion**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 12 archived performances [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-24.nak300.andrewf.113002.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd91-03-24.schoeps.oconnor.12093.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 167 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has people talking throughout the whole show [23]
- **gd91-03-24.sbd.ladner.18119.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard reviewer calls the sound quality good [18]
- **gd1991-03-24.149546.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 170 min [4]
- **gd91-03-24.sbd.hinko.25274.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is clean with every instrument well placed in the mix; Recording and mix are strong; Bobby is quite prominent in the mix [19][21]

## Around the show

- Jerry's voice is ragged but powerful and expressive; Bobby's playing is creative and not obnoxious [21]
- Reviewer's first show, having crossed the border; nearly trampled by a police horse outside [26]
- Security at the Knick marked tickets with an S for smoking or leaving seats; second offense meant ejection [29]
- Ticket-marked fans ended up in the upper deck behind the drums and partied there [29]
- Reviewer says the 1990 Albany shows were even smokier than this one [19]
- Reviewer finds the show only okay, even for 1991, and rated below other highly rated shows [25]
- Reviewer finds the show somewhat overrated; sound is great but performance falls short of a great show [26]
- Attendee of 35 shows in 1991 ranks this in their top five of that year [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-24.nak300.andrewf.113002.flac1644**: transferred by Andrew F. and Andrew F; source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > Maxell DM Dat. Mics on 7-foot stand, front row OTS. [1]
- **gd91-03-24.schoeps.oconnor.12093.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD> DAT> CDR [2]
- **gd91-03-24.sbd.ladner.18119.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>CM>DAT>Cx>CDR>WAV>SHN [3]
- **gd1991-03-24.149546.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer By Charlie Miller Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 12, 2020; source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (110°) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: @ soundboard, section 5, row F, seat 8 [4]
- **gd91-03-24.sbd.hinko.25274.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-24 Sat Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1251622153378/grateful-dead-live-at-knickerbocker) [31]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-03-25 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-03-25-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [32]
